clocks.primary_start: actual browser Render click after uploading/selecting data and entering frozen intent
clocks.first_image: actual current-revision image decoded and mounted; distinguish provisional versus final, record no-provisional-observed explicitly
clocks.final_result: actual current final strict result rendered, with expected status/exit and original final PNG/artifacts/maps; use final-failure latency for original negatives, verified time only for passed results
included: current final report/map binding and DOM
clocks.summary: per case and exact edit seven ordinary medians/p90s; no pooling changed titles/DPI, no exclusion of slower/failed/partial/negative attempts
clocks.png_only_control: report separately; early-image benefit may be absent, do not insert artificial delay into performance runs
